source_text: Dederunt Iesu civitatem Thamnathsare in monte Ephraim — portio ducis. Christus in nobis sortem suam habet. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They-gave to-Jesus city Timnath-serah in mountain Ephraim — portion of-leader. Christ in us lot his has. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[They gave Jesus the city Timnath-serah in Ephraim’s hill country >> Bible:Joshua 19:49-50]] — the leader’s portion. Christ holds his lot in us. Amen.
